summary.title: BIOS and Workload Tuning Guide for AMD EPYC 9004 Series Processors (58011)
summary.one_liner: AMD's official guide to BIOS settings and workload tuning for EPYC 9004 Series processors, covering NPS modes, NUMA behavior, and interconnect topology.
takeaways: The guide is AMD document 58011, revision 1.0, released 2025-05-09.
It describes the EPYC 9004 I/O die and the GMI and xGMI interconnect links.
It explains the NPS modes and the memory interleave width each one produces.
It documents a cache-as-NUMA override as a BIOS option for topology tuning.
summary.summary: This is AMD document 58011 (revision 1.0, dated 2025-05-09), a BIOS and workload tuning guide for AMD EPYC 9004 Series processors. According to the listing, it covers the I/O die, GMI and xGMI links, the NPS modes with their interleave widths, and the cache-as-NUMA override. The fetched page text is mostly cookie-consent boilerplate and the document title block, so the detailed tuning content was not visible in what was captured.
